title: My Pixar Story
summary: A 60-second 16:9 stylized-3D animated memoir in which a parent or grandparent narrates four 15-second beats of their own life to one recipient, in their own consented cloned voice. Built from Wiggly's internal format spec and supervised studio runs, not cloned from a reference video, so no reference media or hash exists.

rules.description: Exactly 60 s at 1920x1080 30 fps: four fixed 15-second narration windows; contiguous frame-aligned clips cover 1800 frames.
First-person narration by the maker to one named recipient, natural rate, never sped up; voice clone only from a consented sample of the maker.
Every name, place, object, date and quote traces to the maker's answers (grounded-v1).
Answers, recipient, traits, tone, cast, shots, prompts, clips, narration and optional music are replaceable input content; the renderer and runner never change per story.

inputs.description: MyPixarStoryInputs JSON (subject, Golden 5 answers, consented voice capture, tone); see docs/proofs.
Generated or supplied clips (>= slot length) and four narration files (<= 15 s each), imported by runner.mjs manifest.

runtime.approach: Node runner + official Remotion memoir-film composition + FFmpeg mix and technical gate

limitations: No paid production film has been reviewed from this standalone repo; proofs are offline placeholder pipeline renders.

proofs.description: Father-to-daughter public-figure story (tech founder, warm tearjerker tone) rendered offline through the official runtime with placeholder visuals and system-voice narration.
Father-to-daughter public-figure story (musician, triumphant tone, different traits and arc) rendered offline through the same runtime with no runtime changes.
